data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 argues that a weaker independent engine may give a false positive due to an inability to parse the error, while a stronger single engine can leverage higher-order reasoning to pinpoint its own failure mode. But it never identifies what in-record evidence would distinguish a genuine self-correction from a restatement; the mechanism presupposes the very independence distinction the problem asks it to evidence. No counting or execution test is supplied.
